featureOwnership: Video pre-buffering and caching for seamless transitions
Rapt Engine layer integration and rendering
Playback state persistence across video nodes (volume, captions, audio track, playback rate)
Custom UI presets for interactive playback controls
Analytics interception for KAVA (Kaltura Video Analytics)
Project lifecycle management (load, ready, start, ended, replay, reset)
dataHandling: Node navigation state (current node, previous node, next nodes)
Player buffering state and buffer list management
Hotspot objects with positions, styles, and click actions
Video playback persistence (mute, volume, captions, audio track, playback rate)
Analytics model with rootEntryId, nodeId, entryId

Web applications embedding Kaltura interactive videos
